metadata.method: Production build; local HTTP; installed system font fallback; one active page; alternating engine order. Output waits for the final marker in the parsed buffer and one following animation frame; write callbacks are not used for timing. Input is synthetic keydown with local echo and two frames; neither metric measures GPU presentation. Heap statistics are Chromium CDP observations, not total process memory. Fresh contexts do not imply a cold browser process or cold OS cache.
